register: Private research register (chris-experiments / rsl programme). Scoped arm outcomes only; hypotheses, corpora and instrument paths are not republished.

architecture.note: Every sixth layer reads the whole context. The planted source sits far outside the 1024-token sliding window, so these eight are the only path to it.

corpus.question: What is the vault access code for the Meridian facility?
corpus.note: One synthetic 64K corpus, byte-identical across the arms below. The source sentence asserts 7431 at 15% depth, roughly 55,000 tokens before the question; the promoted record is the compact string ' Meridian.code=5824. '

promotion.label: EXP-29 / supply versus override
promotion.injection: Every arm injects exactly 72 tokens, so the question always sits at the same absolute position and RoPE phase.

arms.detail: Source live, nothing promoted. Reproduces the reference exactly and doubles as a determinism check.
The contradicting record is readable and is not read. The divergence sits inside the spread of the supply arms — indistinguishable from promoting nothing.
More companions do not help. Override never qualifies at any tested size.
Source retired, nothing promoted. The answer collapses, which is what proves the source was necessary.
One compact record restores the answer with the source retired. Supply qualifies at a single record.
A different run, on the same corpus and injection position, promoting the byte-identical record. With the source retired the same string that was inert above steers the answer.

gate.label: EXP-31 / layer attribution
gate.measured: The source is retired from the selected global layers only; the promoted record and everything else is held byte-identical. 15 of the 256 possible subsets were run.

arms.detail: Nothing retired. Reproduces EXP-29 and EXP-30 on a sixth independent prefill.
One blocked read. The span stays fully readable in the other seven global layers, including every later one, and the promoted record takes the answer.
The only other single layer showing any movement at all.
Reproduces EXP-30's early_3 to four decimals.
Three blocked reads, evenly spread, no mid-stack layer. Does not move at all.
The same number of blocked reads as triple_spread, and the opposite outcome. Count does not explain the effect.
Flips without containing layer 29. A second route to the same outcome.
Flips containing neither 29 nor any late layer. A third route.
Full retirement. The recorded outcome is the answer; the register entry reviewed does not quote a divergence for this arm.

walk.label: EXP-26 / composition along a relational walk
walk.note: The true and decoy links sit at identical positions in both layouts. Only one unrelated 11-token sentence moves. Layout B's South → Corvin is a correct traversal of the decoy chain.
